title: Protocol for evaluating antitumor activity of KIR3DL3 blockade in an NK cell-based xenogeneic lung tumor model
protocol: Thaw frozen PBMCs quickly in a 37°C water bath with gentle agitation by hand.
Dilute thawed cells to 10 mL with PBMC media in a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min at 20°C–22°C.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend cells with fresh PBMC media.
Transfer the cell suspension to a T-75 flask at a density of 5–10 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Incubate cells in humidified incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 12–16 h.
Collect PBMCs by running them through a 40 μm cell strainer into a 50 mL conical tube.
Count the cells, centrifuge for 5 min at 500 × g, 4°C.
Wash cells once with MACS buffer and spin down for 5 min at 500 × g, 4°C.
Reserve 1/10 autologous PBMCs as feeder cells before NK cell enrichment.
Resuspend cell pellet in 40 μL MACS buffer per 10^7 cells.
Add 5 μL NK cell Biotin-Antibody Cocktail per 10^7 cells.
Mix well and incubate for 10 min at 4°C.
Add an additional 30 μL MACS buffer per 10^7 cells.
Add 10 μL NK cell MicroBead Cocktail per 10^7 cells.
Incubate for 20 min at 4°C.
Place a LS column onto QuadroMACS™ Separator attached to MACS MultiStand.
Rinse column with 3 mL MACS buffer.
Apply cells onto the column.
Collect flow-through containing NK cells in a 15 mL conical tube.
Wash column twice with 3 mL buffer and collect in the same tube.
Count cells.
Spin cells down for 5 min at 500 × g.
Resuspend cells at 5 × 10^6 cells/mL in MACS buffer.
Sort KIR3DL3+ NK cells from enriched NK cells.
Co-culture sorted KIR3DL3+ NK cells with irradiated autologous PBMCs as feeder cells for 5-6 days.
Expand cells without feeder cells for an additional 1-2 weeks to obtain the desired number of cells.
Resuspend cells at a concentration of 5 × 10^6 cells/mL in MACS buffer.
Block human FcR on NK cells with FcR blocking reagent diluted 1:10 in MACS buffer for 10-15 minutes at 20°C–22°C.
Add PE anti-KIR3DL3 mAb 26E10 (1:300) and APC anti-human CD3 (1:300) to stained cells, incubate for 30-40 minutes at 4°C.
Wash cells twice with MACS buffer.
First wash – Add 10 mL buffer to stained cells, spin down at 500 × g for 5 minutes at 20°C–22°C, aspirate supernatant.
Second wash – Resuspend cell pellet in 10 mL FACS buffer, spin down at 500 × g for 5 minutes at 20°C–22°C, aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend cells at 5 × 10^6 cells/mL in FACS buffer.
Transfer the resuspended cells to a 5 mL tube with cell strainer cap.
Sort CD3- KIR3DL3+ cells based on the gating strategy.
Prepare feeder cells by collecting reserved autologous PBMCs from step 2 in a 15 mL conical tube.
Irradiate the feeder cells at 30 Gy using a Cesium-137 radioactive source.
Wash irradiated feeder cells with PBMC media once.
Mix sorted CD3- KIR3DL3+ cells with irradiated feeder cells at a ratio of 1:10–20 (NK:feeder cells).
Spin the cell mixture down at 500 × g for 5 min at 20°C–22°C.
Aspirate the supernatant from the spun-down cell mixture.
Resuspend cells at 2–3 × 10^6 cells/mL in NK cell feeding media.
Culture cells in the incubator for 5–6 days.
Transfer cells to a larger flask and culture in NK cell expansion media without feeder cells for additional 1–2 weeks.
Check cell number and viability twice a week.
Replenish fresh NK cell expansion media every 1–2 days to maintain cells at a density of 2–3 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Collect expanded KIR3DL3+ NK cells on days 10–14 after sorting for freezing or storage in liquid nitrogen if needed.
Typically store 10–30 × 10^6 cells per mL of freezing media.
Place 0.1–0.5 × 10^6 cells per well in a 96-well round bottom plate.
Wash cells once with 200 μL of FACS buffer.
Spin cells down at 650 × g for 2 min at 4°C.
Resuspend cells with 50 μL of human FcR blocking reagent diluted 1:10 in FACS buffer and incubate for 10 min at 20°C–22°C.
Add PE anti-KIR3DL3 mAb 26E10 (1:300), FITC anti-human CD56 (1:200), and APC anti-human CD3 (1:300) without washing cells.
Incubate for 30–40 minutes at 4°C.
Wash twice with 200 μL of FACS buffer.
Resuspend cells in 200–300 μL of FACS buffer supplemented with DAPI (1:1,000).
Pre-incubate NK cells with isotype control mIgG1.
Pre-incubate NK cells with anti-KIR3DL3 mAb 26E10.
Harvest 2 × 10^6 expanded KIR3DL3+ NK cells into a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge cells for 5 min at 500 × g at 20°C–22°C.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend cells in HCC827 media at 1 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Divide cells into three parts.
Add 10 μg/mL of mIgG1, 26E10, or equal volume of PBS to each part.
Incubate for 45 min at 20°C–22°C without washing cells.
Label HCC827 cells with PKH26 dye.
Harvest HCC827 cells.
Wash cells once with PBS.
Centrifuge cells for 5 min at 500 × g at 20°C–22°C.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend cells in Diluent C buffer at a concentration of 5–10 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Add an equal volume of PKH26 working solution to the HCC827 cell suspension.
Incubate for 2 min at 20°C–22°C.
Add 10 × volume of HCC827 media and incubate for 3–5 min at 20°C–22°C.
Wash cells three times with 5 mL of HCC827 media.
Centrifuge cells for 5 min at 500 × g, 20°C–22°C after each wash.
Resuspend cells in HCC827 media at a density of 1 × 10^5 cells/mL.
Protect labeled cells from light.
Mix cells by gently pipetting.
Centrifuge plate for 2 min at 110 × g.
Incubate plate in the incubator for 4–5 h.
Analyze by flow cytometry.
Centrifuge plate for 2 min at 650 × g at 20°C–22°C after incubation.
Resuspend cells in 200 μL/well with FACS buffer supplemented with 7-AAD (1:150).
Prepare and expand KIR3DL3+ NK cells according to previous experiments' NK expansion data.
Determine the timing to obtain the required number of NK cells.
Trypsinize HCC827-Luc2 cells at approximately 80%–90% confluency into 50 mL conical tubes.
Centrifuge cells for 5 min at 500 × g, 4°C.
Wash cells three times with sterile PBS.
Resuspend cells in PBS at a density of 2.5 × 10^6/mL.
Filter resuspended cells through a 40 μm cell strainer before counting.
Mix the cell suspension and inject i.v. 200 μL of cells (5 × 10^5 cells) into each mouse's tail vein using a 1 mL syringe with a 30-gauge needle.
Perform bioluminescence imaging (BLI) on mice.
Place mice into an anesthetic induction chamber with isoflurane 2.0% and a flow rate of 2 L/min until fully anesthetized.
Mix mice i.p. with 150 mg/kg D-luciferin.
Wait three minutes after the D-luciferin injection.
Image the mice every 3 min for a total of 15 min using an IVIS Spectrum Imaging platform and Living Image software.
Determine total flux (p/s) by creating a region of interest over the lungs of each mouse.
Return the mice to their cages after imaging.
Monitor the mice until fully recovered from anesthesia.
Allocate mice to 26E10 and mIgG1 treatment groups with similar average tumor burden.
Collect KIR3DL3+ NK cells into 50 mL conical tubes.
Centrifuge cells for 5 min at 500 × g, 4°C.
Wash cells three times with sterile PBS.
Repeat centrifugation after each wash step.
Resuspend cells in PBS at a density of 7–8 × 10^7/mL.
Prepare an excess of 20% of cells.
Keep cells on ice until inoculation.
Add equal volume of mixture of antibody and cytokine (1 μg rhIL-2, 1 μg rhIL-15, and 200 μg 26E10 or mIgG1 per mouse) to cell suspension (7–8 × 10^6 cells/mouse).
Mix well.
Inject i.v. 200 μL into the tail vein of each mouse using a 1 mL syringe with a 30-gauge needle.
Repeat treatment on day 7 and day 9.
Monitor tumor status bi-weekly through bioluminescence imaging throughout the study.
Determine the D-luciferin kinetic curve for the tumor models of interest prior to starting in vivo experiments.
Inject D-luciferin into the subject.
Begin imaging three minutes after D-luciferin injection.
Perform serial imaging every 3 minutes for a total duration of 15 minutes.
